races.paceDynamic: Lazzar will likely take the early lead with Lodge, Thunderous Love and Addictive providing prominent support, creating a genuine pace for this 6f handicap. The soft ground will prevent any breakneck gallop, allowing the pace to be sustainable rather than destructive. With 7 of 11 runners holding up or racing mid-division, the field will bunch up turning for home as the hold-up horses make their moves. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses and those racing handy who can quicken off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine but sustainable allowing closers to pick up the pieces
scenarios.body: The soft ground plays into the hands of those racing patiently as Lazzar and Lodge set honest fractions. Supreme King, Arantes Nascimento and Distant Rumble get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Handy Horse Capitalises
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can slip the field turning for home
scenarios.body: Lodge or Thunderous Love uses their forward position to steal a march on the hold-up brigade. The soft conditions suit both horses and their tactical edge proves decisive as the closers leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Lazzar goes too slow early and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace turns this into a 2f dash where the best turn of foot wins regardless of position. Invincible Speed and Phoenix Moon benefit most from their recent runs and sharper condition.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lazzar Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: With his proven front-running ability Lazzar dictates throughout and finds enough in reserve to hold off late challengers. The soft ground doesn't inconvenience him as much as expected given his recent excuses.

Lodge returns from nearly two-month break but showed clear soft ground ability at Windsor when second

races.paceDynamic: Areti and Hugh are the confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, with both having shown they can dictate from the front. Their clash should create an honest gallop over this 7f trip on testing soft ground, preventing any crawling early fractions. The large field of 14 runners means those settling in midfield positions like Bright Summer and Bold Shout will need to navigate traffic, while the many hold-up horses will be relying on a strong pace to set up their finishing kicks. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with early speed who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the back markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Clash Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Areti and Hugh engage in a prolonged speed duel from the gates
scenarios.body: The honest pace will set up perfectly for prominent racers like Bright Summer and Bold Shout to strike in the final furlong as the leaders tire on the testing ground. The strong gallop prevents any kick-back scenarios that would favour the many hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates Early
scenarios.trigger: If either Areti or Hugh gets an uncontested lead while the other settles
scenarios.body: The lone leader controls the fractions and stays strong late, while those tracking in second or third position like Dupont Circle get first run on any faltering pace-setter. Hold-up horses still face traffic issues in the big field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses including Bold Shout and Dupont Circle join the early pace contest
scenarios.body: The fractious early pace creates gaps for the better hold-up horses like Rajiba and Lucky Luna to exploit, as several front runners compound each other. The testing ground amplifies the advantage of those conserving energy early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Debutant Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Le Samourai shows immediate professional debut class despite being unknown quantity
scenarios.body: The expensive, well-bred newcomer from the Beckett stable bypasses traffic issues that plague exposed runners and benefits from the strong early pace. His half-brother Romantic Warrior's class suggests he could be anything on debut.

runners_data.note: Only proven front-runner with solid recent form and handles soft ground, key pace angle
runners_data.spotlight: Showed plenty when a 1l second at Kempton (1m, AW) on his debut in April and built on that when second of 11 at Newbury (1m2f, good) 25 days ago; dam finished runner-up in a Group 1 on testing ground; sets the standard.

runners_data.name: Long Reign
runners_data.note: Poor form horse who fades badly in finishes, gelded since debut flop
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in two starts (gelded before latest) and he isn't easy to recommend
runners_data.spotlight: Showed little on his debut at Newbury (1m, good; 125-1; subsequently gelded) and again finished well beaten at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) 29 days ago; not easy to recommend.

runners_data.name: Last Trump
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist dropping back in trip but proven soft ground performer for patient Hornby
runners_data.comment: Shaped with promise on debut (1m3f) but didn't build on that here over 1m4f last time
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped with promise at Newbury (1m3f, good) in April but wasn't able to build on that when fourth of eight here over 1m4f (good to firm) 37 days ago; drops to 1m2f and looks the type to do better when handicapping.

runners_data.name: Poor Relation
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning from 140-day break with strong AW form and 5lb weight advantage
runners_data.comment: Built on her eye-catching debut when runner-up at Southwell 140 days ago; steps up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Caught the eye when fifth of 11 on her debut at Lingfield (1m, AW) in December and built on that when runner-up at Southwell (1m, AW) 140 days ago, despite hanging left; steps up in trip on her first start since and she's open to further progress.

runners_data.name: Much
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up type who struggled in stronger company but better suited to this grade
runners_data.comment: Well held in eighth on his debut and never featured last time; handicaps may be his thing
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in eighth in a race won by Derby runner-up Maltese Cross at Newbury (1m2f, good) on his debut and never featured over that same C&D 25 days ago; pedigree suggests slightly further may suit, and handicaps may be more his thing.

runners_data.name: Notable Charm
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who fades in finishes despite step up in trip suiting breeding
runners_data.comment: Struggled in two starts over 1m (turf/AW); steps up in trip but handicaps more suitable
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled on his debut at Newbury (1m, good; 150-1) in April and it was the same story at Lingfield (1m, AW) 28 days ago; pedigree suggests this step up in trip will suit but handicaps may be more suitable.

runners_data.name: Easwrith Destiny
runners_data.note: Raced too freely last time but has soft ground experience and prominent style
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in two starts at Newbury and Chepstow; probably one for handicaps later on
runners_data.spotlight: 200-1 when beaten 22l on his debut at Newbury (1m2f, good) in April and again finished well beaten after racing freely at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft) 19 days ago; probably one for handicaps later on.

runners_data.name: Cartrefle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 201-day layoff with poor recent form but distance may help
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off when last of seven on his debut at Redcar (1m1f, good to soft) in October and he again failed to beat a rival home at Southwell (1m, AW) next time; others are preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Besieged is the only confirmed front-runner in this 11-runner field and will likely get an uncontested lead on the soft ground. The prominent runners Notable Charm and Easwrith Destiny may press but both have shown tendencies to fade, leaving Besieged to dictate terms. With limited early pace, this sets up as a steady gallop that will quicken late over the extended 1m2f trip. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, particularly those with stamina and soft ground ability.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Besieged sets modest fractions and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace allows closers to time their runs perfectly while early leaders tire on testing ground. Last Trump, Poor Relation and Much benefit from patient rides and strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class breakthrough wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the Gosden or Fellowes debutants shows immediate high-class ability
scenarios.body: Centrum or Traveling Man overcomes inexperience to win on talent alone, with pedigree and connections overcoming tactical disadvantage. Their superior breeding tells in the final furlong despite suboptimal positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner holds on
scenarios.trigger: If Besieged kicks clear turning for home before others can respond
scenarios.body: His fitness advantage and proven form at the trip allows him to build an unassailable lead on horses making debut or returning from breaks. The soft ground saps the finishing kick from pursuers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo becomes crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of style, favouring those who stay closest to the pace. Notable Charm or Easwrith Destiny could surprise if staying on better than recent form suggests.

watchPoints.text: Besieged must be watched early - if he faces unexpected pressure from prominent runners, his stamina reserves could be compromised
Poor Relation returning after 140 days off - watch for market support and how sharp she looks in preliminaries given the long absence
Centrum and Traveling Man both making debuts for top connections - any significant market moves would suggest homework has been impressive
Notable Charm and Easwrith Destiny both showed pace before fading previously - if either travels strongly into straight they could surprise at big odds
Last Trump dropping back from 1m4f to 1m2f - watch how Hornby positions him as trip reduction could either help or hinder his finishing kick

races.name: Everywhen Margadale Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Affection
runners_data.note: Unknown running style makes her tactical role unpredictable, plus 54 days off and French form hard to assess
runners_data.comment: Won four of her ten starts in France, the most recent coming over 1m4f; stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Previously trained in France and she's won four of her ten starts, the most recent win coming by a neck in a claimer at Salon-de-Provence (1m4f, good to soft) 54 days ago; drops back in trip for her stable/British debut and the betting should be informative.

runners_data.name: Regal Charm
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning from 228-day layoff but proven course winner with soft ground form
runners_data.comment: Won a 1m novice at Newmarket last year; ran well over 1m2f on her h'cap debut 228 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Won a novice at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last August on her second start and ran well in a handicap at Newbury (1m2f, soft) 228 days ago; off since but she should have a bit more to offer after just five starts.

runners_data.name: Jazzy Baby
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up from all-weather to turf for first time this season
runners_data.comment: Sole win came in a maiden at Kempton (1m) but disappointing latest; steps up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win from eight starts came in a maiden at Kempton (1m, AW) in January and she's posted some solid efforts there in handicaps since; however, she now steps up in trip following a poor effort there 40 days ago and needs to bounce back on her turf debut.

runners_data.name: Typical Woman
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent soft ground record but winless for over a year
runners_data.comment: Below her best this year but drops in grade off her last winning mark; cheekpieces back on
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced on soft but handles good to soft; below her best in three starts this year but now drops back in grade off the same mark as when winning at Lingfield (1m1f, good to firm) last year; returning cheekpieces are another plus.

runners_data.name: Rossa Raheen
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying just 120lbs with David Probert's 7lb claim, improving three-year-old
runners_data.comment: Posted an improved effort on her handicap debut at Newbury (1m2f); big player
runners_data.spotlight: Ran to a similar level in two starts last year for David Menuisier (1m, soft/good to soft) and posted an improved effort despite not getting the best of runs in a handicap at Newbury (1m2f, good) 25 days ago on her second start for this stable; unexposed and looks a big player.

runners_data.name: Albus Anne
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with outstanding soft/heavy ground record, 188 days off but loves Bath conditions
runners_data.comment: All five wins have been at Bath but third in both starts over this C&D; goes well on soft
runners_data.spotlight: All five of her wins have been at Bath (1m/1m2f) with four of them on soft/heavy, the latest over 1m2f in October off a 4lb lower mark than today's; third in both starts over this C&D and she's proven fresh, so is of some interest on her first start for 188 days.

runners_data.name: Royal Poetry
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won last time out but stepping back up in grade
runners_data.comment: Good second of four over C&D on her handicap debut but disappointing last time
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt when making all in a novice at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) in April before finishing a good second of four over this C&D (good to firm) on her handicap debut; however, she was disappointing at Newmarket 24 days ago and needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Morven
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven soft ground form but needs to bounce back from poor recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Disappointed in a Listed event on her final start at two but ran well on her return (8.5f)
runners_data.spotlight: Won a novice at Hamilton (1m, good to soft) in September on her second start but was well beaten in a Listed event at Pontefract (1m, soft) next time; good effort when beaten a head at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) on her reappearance and has solid claims if seeing out this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Regal Charm will likely set the pace with Jazzy Baby and Royal Poetry settling just behind in prominent positions, creating a moderate gallop over the extended trip on testing ground. The lack of confirmed early pace means the tempo could be steady rather than fierce, with the hold-up horses Typical Woman, Rossa Raheen, Albus Anne and Morven tracking from midfield and rear. On soft ground over 1m2f with limited early pressure, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can finish powerfully from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady and hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop sets up perfectly for the back-markers to unleash sustained finishes, with soft ground aiding stamina-laden types. Typical Woman, Albus Anne and Morven all excel when allowed to close from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Persist
scenarios.trigger: If Regal Charm and Jazzy Baby kick clear turning in
scenarios.body: The front two maintain their advantage as the closing brigade fails to get organized or encounters traffic problems in the straight. Their early positioning proves decisive when the expected late charge doesn't materialize with sufficient force.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Mover Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Rossa Raheen gets the perfect trip tracking the leaders
scenarios.body: The lightly-weighted three-year-old times her challenge to perfection, picking up the pieces when the pace collapses but avoiding the traffic that snares the hold-up horses. Her improved recent form translates to victory under tactical riding from Probert.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: French Import Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Affection shows improved fitness after her French import
scenarios.body: The unknown quantity produces a bold front-running or prominent performance that catches the field off-guard. Her previous French form proves stronger than anticipated, and she handles the soft conditions better than her rivals.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Affection shows early pace intent as this could completely change the complexion with an unknown front-runner
Monitor Regal Charm's fitness after 228-day absence as she may not sustain her usual front-running role
Check Albus Anne's early position as her hold-up style needs the pace to develop properly
Watch for traffic problems in straight as multiple hold-up horses will be looking for room simultaneously
Observe Rossa Raheen's positioning under Probert as her light weight could be crucial if pace collapses

races.name: Charter 1227 Catering Handicap

runners_data.name: Tenzi
runners_data.note: Only front runner who can dictate the pace, 11 days since last run ideal for fitness
runners_data.comment: Won AW novice in March but hasn't posed a serious threat in handicaps subsequently
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise on turf last summer (good/soft ) and won a novice at Southwell (7f, AW) this March; however, she hasn't posed a serious threat in two handicaps subsequently (6f, AW/good to firm) and needs something extra today.

runners_data.name: Grand Vista
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits soft ground where he has winning form, Tom Marquand booking significant
runners_data.spotlight: He's shown hints of promise among his three starts (including on soft ground) and his pedigree provides optimism that he can prove better than his opening mark; wears first-time blinkers.

runners_data.name: Yes Waliim
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner using 7lb claimer, struggling in handicaps this season
runners_data.spotlight: 0-5 and unable to make an impact this year in his first two handicaps; however, he made late headway when 4l sixth of eight at Lingfield last time (5f, good; unraced on softer) and might have a part to play back up to 6f.

runners_data.name: Marra Donna
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but hung badly left on turf last time, mainly an AW performer
runners_data.comment: 0-9 and below par on turf last time but on a handy mark on this year's consistent AW form
runners_data.spotlight: Made it 0-9 and he wasn't at his best (hung badly left) on a rare turf start at Windsor (6f, good; fifth) three weeks ago; needs to prove he can get the job done but he's on a handy mark on his consistent AW form earlier this year; not written off.

runners_data.name: Madman
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner better on AW than turf, soft ground form modest from limited evidence
runners_data.comment: Won on AW in January but below best on turf on first two outings for this stable
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Kempton (6f, AW) in January and he's on a good mark on his peak AW form; however, he hasn't been at his best back on turf on his first two outings for this stable, and is 0-9 on grass.

runners_data.name: Wayward Queen
runners_data.note: Bottom weight hold-up runner from top yard, basement mark offers value angle
runners_data.comment: She's achieved little but is with a top trainer and goes handicapping off a basement mark
runners_data.spotlight: She's achieved little this spring on her first three starts (6f, good to firm/AW/good); however, she's with a top trainer and goes handicapping off a basement mark in first-time headgear; interesting contender.

runners_data.name: That's Random
runners_data.note: Hold-up type having first run for 36 days, breeding suggests improvement possible
runners_data.spotlight: He's not obviously well treated off this opening mark but has shown some ability among his first three starts (7f/6f, AW) and is bred to be better than this grade; no surprise if he takes a sizeable step forward.

runners_data.name: Barry The Worm
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner wearing cheekpieces, 40 days off is concerning for fitness
runners_data.comment: AW nursery win on final 2yo starts and reappearance sixth gives him something to build on
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the seventh attempt when wearing first-time cheekpieces (retained since) in a nursery at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last November; April's reappearance sixth at Southwell (6f, AW) gives him something to build on and he's a possible contender if the return to turf isn't an issue.

runners_data.name: Maid In Devon
runners_data.note: Recent C&D winner suited to hold-up role, 5lb rise and slower ground potential concerns
runners_data.comment: Won in big field over C&D last month; may have more to offer now things have clicked
runners_data.spotlight: Built upon first two handicap performances to win in a big field over C&D last month (good; Stock Market second); 5lb higher today and slower ground is forecast, but she may have more to offer now things have clicked.

runners_data.name: Stock Market
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades in finish, failed to settle last time at Chepstow
runners_data.comment: 0-12 and below his best last time, but close second of 15 over C&D two starts ago; chance
runners_data.spotlight: 12-race maiden who failed to settle when below par at Chepstow (5f, good to soft) latest; however, seven days earlier he was a close second to Maid In Devon over C&D (good) and can be thereabouts if bouncing back.

runners_data.name: Follow My Heart
runners_data.note: Light weight hold-up runner, stablemate of recent winner Maid In Devon
runners_data.comment: Fourth of 15 over C&D on last month's handicap debut and she's open to improvement
runners_data.spotlight: No match for stablemate Maid In Devon and Stock Market when fourth of 15 on last month's handicap debut over C&D (good), which came after a break; she has a useful pedigree and is open to improvement, especially if her efforts are channeled in a straight line (hung right last time).

runners_data.name: Grimese's Special
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with soft ground win here, poor recent form on faster surfaces
runners_data.comment: Heavy-ground seller win here last September; return to slow ground needs to prompt revival
runners_data.spotlight: She's been very disappointing on her three starts (1m/7f, AW/good) since winning a seller here (7f, heavy) last September on her second start; the return to slow ground needs to prompt a dramatic revival.

races.paceDynamic: Tenzi appears the only natural front runner in this field, giving her an uncontested lead through moderate early fractions on the soft ground. With 11 hold-up horses behind her, the pace will be sedate early before building through the middle furlongs as the field closes up. The soft conditions will make sustained kicks harder, creating a more even contest in the final furlong where stamina becomes crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track Tenzi closely and hold-up horses with proven soft ground form who can stay on when others tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tenzi Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Tenzi gets an easy lead and dictates moderate fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: Her sustainable pace on testing ground allows her to kick clear turning in while the hold-up brigade struggle to make up ground on the slower surface. William Carver can time her effort perfectly with no pace pressure early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and the field bunches up entering the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The soft ground helps stamina-laden hold-up horses like Grand Vista and those with proven soft form mount sustained challenges. Tom Marquand on Grand Vista times his run to perfection as Tenzi's early advantage gets neutralized.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Form Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Maid In Devon reproduces her recent C&D win despite the 5lb rise and slower conditions
scenarios.body: Oisin Murphy gets her into a perfect tracking position behind Tenzi before unleashing her finishing kick. The class edge from her recent victory over Stock Market proves decisive on familiar territory.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the combination of soft ground and 6f trip catches the market leaders out of their comfort zone
scenarios.body: A lightly-weighted runner like Follow My Heart or an improving type like That's Random benefits from the testing conditions. The pace collapse allows a big-priced runner to emerge from the pack late.

watchPoints.text: Stock Market has a tendency to fade in the finish and failed to settle last time, making him unreliable in betting
Maid In Devon faces a 5lb penalty for her recent C&D win and slower ground than her winning conditions
Barry The Worm returns after 40 days off which raises fitness concerns despite his cheekpieces
Follow My Heart gets useful weight allowance and represents the same stable as recent winner Maid In Devon
Tenzi will reveal early if she's keen or settling kindly as the lone pace angle, crucial for race development
